claim: Loop prediction problems become intractable when loop length exceeds 10 residues and surrounding side-chain conformations are erased, requiring methods that can systematically search all-atom conformational space.
falsifier: Systematically vary loop length and side-chain treatment in a benchmark and measure the success rate of coarse-grained methods versus enumerative all-atom search.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported loop prediction challenges; intractability may also depend on other factors such as loop sequence and protein context.

title: Loop length exceeding 10–intractability for coarse-grained boundary
